basis: User explicitly requires short natural tasks with no reading/retrieval hints; prior accepted requirements remain the oracle.
prompt_gate: Only short task, workspace and execution restrictions.
No documents/index/decisions lookup request; no file or ADR IDs, search order/keywords, expected conclusion, or request to report read files/commands.
Fresh low-reasoning context; prior answers and scoring excluded from candidate.

compact_docs: Independently finds ownership and maintenance rules through normal entry.
Preserves effective requirements, distinguishes semantic/retrieval changes from pure formatting and applies appropriate behavioral validation without being asked how to verify.
format_only: Independently consults relevant guidance; no unrelated product/model tests or automatic semantic probe for a strictly typographic task.
Checks structure/diff; would reclassify actual meaning/entry changes.
window_ownership: Independently finds relevant subsystem and actual decisions/contracts, not only a guess or metadata.
Distinguishes presentation/coordination optimization from retained Host persistence, asset permission and handoff authority; no product acceptance inferred.

grading: Final correctness alone does not prove a usable index. Parent checks actual tool reads. Preserve failure, fix real material/lookup cause, rerun a fresh equivalent brief task without adding lookup hints.
